title: Transport a constant perfect realization across the stratum coefficient comparison
statement: Let T and S be schemes, g:S→T any morphism, and E/Q_l a finite extension. Let d be an adic datum on O_E with ideal generated by its recorded uniformizer and c a normalized IntegralResidueCoefficientModel on S [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-coefficient-model]. Let F be integralResidueStratumPull, the exact inverse image followed by normalized scalar restriction [lem-weil-pbc-integral-residue-stratum-input]. For every perfect complex P over O_E [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], there is a perfect complex Q over PbcIntegralRing=ULift(O_E) such that F(integralConstantDerived_T(Q)) is isomorphic to completedAdicDerivedChange_S(completedAdicScalar)(residueLisseDerivedConstant_S(P)). This is only compatibility of constant realization with coefficient transport; it has no arbitrary input K, no completeness or residue-chart hypothesis, and no covering conclusion.

proof.text: Choose a bounded finite-projective representative B of P. Construct the coefficient-universe lift termwise using ModuleCat.uliftFunctor followed by restriction along ULift.down. The explicit semilinear equivalence Equiv.ulift transports projectivity and finite generation. Faithfulness and preservation of zero objects preserve both strict bounds, giving the perfect representative B′ and Q=Q(B′).

proof.text: Map the ordinary natural comparison to cochain complexes and then to the derived category. The exact-functor composition and localization factorization isomorphisms identify the left side. Transport the right side along the chosen isomorphism P≅Q(B). The composite supplies the required isomorphism. No claim that arbitrary completedAdicChange is exact is used.

lean.statement:
theorem integralResidueStratum_constant
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (g : S ⟶ T)
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hd : d.ideal = Ideal.span {Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E})
    (c : IntegralResidueCoefficientModel l E d S)
    (P : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))
    (hP : DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex P) :
    ∃ Q : completedConstantDerived (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (PbcIntegralRing l E)),
      @DerivedCategory.IsPerfectRingComplex (PbcIntegralRing l E) _
        (HasDerivedCategory.standard _) Q ∧
      Nonempty
        ((integralResidueStratumPull T l E S g d c).obj
            ((integralConstantDerived T (pbcIntegralDatum l E)).obj Q) ≅
          (completedAdicDerivedChange S (completedAdicScalar S d)).obj
            ((residueLisseDerivedConstant S (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)).obj P))
